subject.title: fix(agents-bind): generate peer format for feishu group bindings

question: Which Feishu bind grammar should OpenClaw support for conversation IDs while preserving existing account-scoped binds?
rationale: The PR changes a public CLI input that writes persisted route bindings, and the repository has multiple competing candidate fixes with different compatibility tradeoffs.

options.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer support
options.body: Keep existing channel/account binds working and add a documented peer grammar or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with an explicit account escape.

options.title: Adopt Feishu two-segment peer default
options.body: Treat Feishu two-segment values as conversation peers by default, but require docs, tests, and upgrade guidance for account-scoped users.

options.title: Pause this branch for a sibling candidate
options.body: Choose another open candidate if it better fits the desired grammar and close the remaining candidate PRs only after one fix is viable or merged.

recommendation.title: Preserve account syntax and add explicit peer support
recommendation.body: Keep existing channel/account binds working and add a documented peer grammar or plugin-owned Feishu conversation recognition with an explicit account escape.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent history across routing and agent CLI documentation, which are the two public contract surfaces involved in this choice.
